## Calibration per head type

- sklearn `LogisticRegression`: use `CalibratedClassifierCV(method="isotonic", cv=5)` wrapper for non-binary settings; `method="sigmoid"` (Platt) for binary with > 200 samples.
- sklearn `RandomForestClassifier`: always isotonic with `cv=5`; uncalibrated RF predict_proba is notoriously over-confident.
- PyTorch MLP: temperature scaling on a held-out calibration split; record the learned temperature in summary.json for reproducibility.

Report Brier score and reliability diagram (10 bins) alongside AUROC.
